suppress.name: Suppress the Breach
suppress.description: Destroy the active guardian and force prison pressure down. Fast and legible, but the old system remains unchanged.

rebind.name: Renew the Binding
rebind.description: Study and restore the failing bonds rather than treating the prisoner as the only problem.

recover_evidence.name: Recover the Record
recover_evidence.description: Prioritize testimony, machinery, and contradictory records that can change later political choices.

negotiate.name: Test a New Covenant
negotiate.description: Approach the contained power as a dangerous party to an agreement. This stabilizes some sites and enrages hardliners.
